mcqs.q: Which is the only floating national park in the world, located on Loktak Lake in Manipur?
mcqs.exp: Keibul Lamjao National Park is composed of floating biomass islands called phumdis and is the last sanctuary of the dancing Sangai deer.

mcqs.q: At which town in Manipur did Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose's Indian National Army (INA) first hoist the tricolor on Indian mainland soil on 14 April 1944?
mcqs.exp: Colonel Shaukat Malik of the INA hoisted the Indian National Flag at Moirang on 14 April 1944.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Manipur.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Imphal. Manipur covers a geographic area of 22,327 sq km across 16 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Imphal, Barak, Iril, Thoubal, Manipur River.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Known as the 'Jewel of India'. Home to Loktak Lake, the largest freshwater lake in Northeast India, featuring floating islands ('Phumdis') and Keibul Lamjao, the world's only floating national park.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Manipur.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Manipur was formally instituted on 21 January 1972. Official language(s): Manipuri (Meitei).

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Manipuri (Classical Dance / Raslila), Thang-Ta (Martial Art), Pung Cholom.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Yaoshang, Sangai Festival, Ningol Chakouba, Cheiraoba.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Manipur.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Lakshman Prasad Acharya (Addl. Charge).

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Manipur is N. Biren Singh.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under High Court of Manipur (Imphal).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Sangai (Brow-antlered deer) | State Bird: Mrs. Hume's pheasant | State Flower: Shirui lily | State Tree: Uningthou.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Manipur.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Chromite, Limestone, Copper.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Manipur plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Manipur.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Kangla Fort, INA Memorial Complex at Moirang (where INA hoisted Indian tricolor on mainland soil in 1944).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Keibul Lamjao National Park (sole habitat of Sangai deer), Sirohi National Park.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Manipur.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Chief Minister-gi Hakshelgi Tengbang (CMHT), Go to Hills Mission.
